newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen gaining, focus on currencies.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen gaining, focus on currencies.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to try for gains on Thursday after falling on Wednesday due to a stronger yen, brokers said. They said focus would continue to be on currencies as well as on position adjustment ahead of the June futures settlement.
On Thursday the Nikkei 225 shed 242.62 points, or 1.18 percent, to finish at 20,289.93. Its June futures closed 290 points lower at 20,310.
"If the yen stabilises near the 111 to the dollar level, a rebound may occur but the upside will probably be capped near 20,500," a general manager at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
